name: trstctl universal external CA high-fidelity emulator contract

entries.external_ca.registry: served registry routes one issue through a configured driver and returns an OpenSSL-verifiable leaf plus chain
entries.external_ca.adcs: exact Basic-authenticated ADCS certsrv request submission, request-id retrieval, and issued PEM chain
entries.external_ca.awspca: canonical SigV4-verified ACM PCA IssueCertificate plus GetCertificate and issued PEM chain
entries.external_ca.azurekv: bearer-authenticated Azure Keys/Managed-HSM JWK read and digest sign; the control plane constructs and verifies the leaf against the operator CA chain while the private key remains remote
entries.external_ca.digicert: CertCentral API-key order, issued-state poll, PEM-chain download
entries.external_ca.ejbca: EJBCA bearer-authenticated pkcs10enroll with DER leaf and chain
entries.external_ca.entrust: TLS 1.3 Entrust CA Gateway enrollment with a pinned server root and a required trusted client certificate; missing and untrusted client identities are rejected at the TLS handshake before the issued chain is returned
entries.external_ca.gcpcas: OAuth-authenticated CAS certificates.create with stable certificate/request ids
entries.external_ca.globalsign: GlobalSign Atlas credentialed certificate request and issued chain
entries.external_ca.letsencrypt: ACME directory/account/order/finalize/certificate exchange with nonce-replay rejection and independently OpenSSL-verified ES256 JWS requests
entries.external_ca.sectigo: SCM credentialed enroll plus collect and PEM chain
entries.external_ca.shellca: literal no-shell signer command crossing the external process boundary and returning a chain
entries.external_ca.smallstep: step-ca sign request carrying an independently verified, audience/issuer/time-bound HS256 provisioner OTT and issued chain
entries.external_ca.vaultpki: Vault-token-authenticated PKI sign request and issued chain
entries.external_ca.venafi: Venafi token-authenticated request/retrieve flow and issued chain

security.authority: ephemeral OpenSSL root key is generated inside the substrate and removed on exit
security.completion: passed is true only after entry-specific authenticated wire operations produce a chain independently verified by OpenSSL; AWS PCA requires a recomputed credential-, region-, service-, header-, and payload-bound SigV4 signature; Entrust requires mutually authenticated TLS 1.3 and independently failed handshakes for absent and untrusted client certificates
